lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns. The centroids maintain a relatively equidistant spacing in the mid-flank region, forming a non-linear grid pattern posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance blobs to create a series of structural nodes. These intersections are most prominent in the central-lateral region where the vertical stripes are most defined.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal linear feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition (high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side, low-intensity shadow on the ventral side).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin exhibits irregular, serrated-like pixel discontinuities, suggesting minor tissue loss or structural erosion.
other_distinctive_markers: A blue elliptical watermark containing the text 'Village Dive' and a diver silhouette is present in the upper right quadrant of the image frame.
